name: GitHub Profile
author: Widgeter
description: A GitHub profile card with followers, repos, total stars, top languages and (with a token) the contribution graph, from the GitHub API.

config.label: GitHub personal access token
config.help: Optional. Needed only for the contribution graph (GitHub serves it through GraphQL, which requires sign-in) and raises the rate limit to 5000 requests/hour. Create one at github.com/settings/tokens with the read:user scope.
